businesses.spotlight_reason: A revived Texoma nightlife institution with deep country-music history, a major regional following, and an active calendar of live bands, dancing, karaoke and special events.
businesses.description: Calhoun's 2.0 is a Denison country dance hall and live-music venue carrying forward one of Texoma's best-known nightlife names. The modern venue pairs an approximately 2,000-square-foot dance floor with a full bar, live bands, karaoke, line dancing, DJs, games and special events.
businesses.why_visit: Come for a true Texoma dance-hall night: live country music, a large dance floor, karaoke and line-dancing nights, a full bar and plenty to do between sets, including pool, darts, cornhole and oversized games.
businesses.why_its_unique: Calhoun's 2.0 revives a name with decades of local country-music history. The original Calhoun's was a well-known Grayson County dance hall that hosted major country acts before its final dance around 2006. The Calhoun's name returned in the former Jake's Place venue, reconnecting that legacy with today's Texoma nightlife scene.
businesses.hours_note: Current listings and recurring programming support Wednesday-Saturday evening hours. Concerts and special events can change opening times, age requirements and cover charges, so check the official event schedule before making a special trip.
good_to_know: Regular nightlife programming is adult-oriented; many events are 18+, but age requirements vary by event.
Cover charges vary by performer and event, and some recurring nights have no cover.
Thursday programming commonly includes karaoke, free line-dancing lessons and a DJ dance party.
Friday and Saturday are primary live-band nights, and special-event hours can differ from regular hours.
businesses.verification_note: Full profile refresh completed August 7, 2026. businesses.service_area_or_location: 513 Cedar Bayou Blvd, Gordonville, TX 76245 — family-owned Lake Texoma marina and resort with boating, lodging, RV accommodations and Cross Timbers Trail access
businesses.description: Cedar Bayou Marina is a family-owned and operated marina and resort on the Texas side of Lake Texoma in Gordonville. Open year-round, the gated property offers open and covered boat slips for vessels from 24 to 60 feet, wet and dry storage, boat-lift options, overnight slips, a boat ramp, fuel dock, covered fishing dock and fish-cleaning station. Cedar Bayou also operates lakefront lodging and an RV park, provides access to independently branded onsite Lake Texoma fishing guides, and serves as a trailhead for the Cross Timbers hiking and mountain-biking trail system.
businesses.short_description: Family-owned Lake Texoma marina in Gordonville with 24–60-foot slips, fuel, boat ramp, fishing facilities, cabins, lake houses, RV sites and Cross Timbers Trail access.
businesses.why_visit: Cedar Bayou works well as a quieter west-Lake-Texoma base for boaters, anglers, hikers, mountain bikers and overnight guests. Visitors can keep or launch a boat, fuel up, fish from the marina, book a guided fishing trip, stay in a cabin or lake house, bring an RV or access miles of Cross Timbers trails directly from the property.
businesses.why_its_unique: Cedar Bayou combines a working Lake Texoma marina with substantial lodging and RV options plus immediate access to the Cross Timbers Trail system. Its current fishing-guide program also brings multiple independently branded guide services directly to the marina, allowing visitors to combine guided fishing with discounted Cedar Bayou lodging.

businesses.hours_note: Current official main and Contact pages state that office hours are seasonal and subject to change. Sunday is specifically published as a summer schedule. An RV-page footer currently displays a conflicting Sunday schedule, so the main/contact schedule is used as the canonical office schedule.

good_to_know: Cedar Bayou Marina is located at 513 Cedar Bayou Blvd in Gordonville, Texas, directly on Lake Texoma.
The current official website describes Cedar Bayou as family-owned and operated and open year-round.
Office hours are seasonal and subject to change.
The marina currently offers open and covered slips for boats from 24 to 60 feet.
Options for 6,500-pound boat lifts are currently advertised.
Both wet and dry storage are offered at annual rates.
Current lodging pages advertise overnight boat slips for $35 per night, subject to availability and price changes.
Current boat-slip material requires current boat insurance for overnight slip reservations.
The marina has a gated entrance and boat-launch area.
A fuel dock is currently operating on the property.
The marina provides a covered fishing dock and fish-cleaning station.
Cedar Bayou is a trailhead/access point for the Cross Timbers Trail system along Lake Texoma.
Current Cedar Bayou material describes approximately 15 to 16 miles of Cross Timbers hiking and mountain-biking access depending on the page and route being described.
The RV park offers both short-term and long-term rentals at daily, weekly and monthly rates.
RV spaces include electric, water and sewer hookups plus pump-out service.
Both pull-through and back-in RV sites are advertised.
Current first-party lodging includes multiple cabins and larger lake-house-style accommodations.
The main website currently advertises eight cabins.
Little Arrow Point Motel is currently marked temporarily unavailable and should not be promoted as presently bookable until that status changes.
Some Cedar Bayou lodging units are pet-friendly while others explicitly prohibit pets, so guests must check the policy for the specific accommodation.
Three Feathers cabins currently allow one pet with a pet cleaning fee.
Juniper Cabin currently allows up to two pets with a pet cleaning fee.
Cross Timbers Hideaway and Lake Point Lookout currently state that pets are not permitted.
Wi-Fi is confirmed in multiple lodging units but is not being represented as free property-wide marina Wi-Fi.
The dedicated current fishing-guide page lists three onsite guide businesses: Flat Water Charters, Mojo Striper Guide Service and Reel Livin Guide Service.

A separate Activities page still says Cedar Bayou has two onsite guides. Because the dedicated guide page currently names and links three businesses, the dedicated guide page is treated as the more specific and current source.
Guests booking with Cedar Bayou's onsite guides are currently offered a 10% lodging discount code.

Flat Water Charters, Mojo Striper Guide Service and Reel Livin Guide Service are independently branded businesses and should be evaluated as separate TWG child records rather than absorbed into Cedar Bayou's own service identity.
Mojo Striper Guide Service independently confirms that it is located at 513 Cedar Bayou Blvd.
Cedar Bayou's cabins, RV park, boat slips, fuel dock, fishing dock and storage operations remain internal marina services rather than separate TWG businesses.

Cross Timbers Hideaway, Lake Point Lookout, Three Feathers and other individually named lodging units are bookable accommodation products operated through Cedar Bayou's own website and contact identity; they should not be treated as separate business children.

TowBoatUS is currently promoted by Cedar Bayou and a marina news announcement states that a TowBoatUS vessel is based at the marina, but this relationship does not make the towing operation an internal Cedar Bayou department.
The current official website displays its contact email through protected/obfuscated markup, so no email address is being inferred from older third-party listings.

The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers currently lists Cedar Bayou Marina as a Lake Texoma marina/concession using the same 903-523-4248 phone number. Its Corps link still points to an older cedarbayou.com domain, while the marina's current active first-party website is cedarbayoumarina.com.
Cedar Bayou maintains an Event Calendar link, but no sufficiently current recurring public event schedule was verified during this research pass.

businesses.business_name: Dragon Thai & Vegetarian Cuisine — Austin Avenue
businesses.service_area_or_location: 613 N Austin Ave, Denison, TX 75020 — original full-service sit-down Dragon Thai location
businesses.description: Dragon Thai & Vegetarian Cuisine's Austin Avenue location is the business's larger traditional sit-down restaurant in Denison. It serves a broad Thai menu including Pad Thai, pho, curries, fried rice, noodles, soups, salads and chef specialties alongside an extensive dedicated vegetarian and vegan-friendly selection. Guests can dine inside, order takeout or use delivery services, with many dishes customizable by protein and spice level.
businesses.short_description: Full-service Denison Thai restaurant with dine-in seating, Pad Thai, pho, curries and an extensive vegetarian and vegan-friendly menu.
businesses.why_visit: The Austin Avenue restaurant is the better Dragon Thai location for guests looking for a traditional sit-down meal. Its broad menu works especially well for groups with mixed dietary preferences because conventional meat and seafood dishes are offered alongside substantial vegetarian and vegan-friendly choices.
businesses.why_its_unique: Dragon Thai goes well beyond offering a few meat-free substitutions. Its vegetarian menu includes tofu and specialty soy-protein dishes while the main menu covers a wide range of Thai favorites, making the restaurant particularly useful for groups containing both omnivores and vegetarian or vegan diners.
businesses.address_note: This Austin Avenue restaurant remains active alongside Dragon Thai's newer 1525 W Morton St location. The Morton location is an additional smaller branch with some seating and a drive-thru; it does not replace the Austin Avenue restaurant.
businesses.hours_note: Current location data lists split lunch and dinner service Monday-Friday, continuous service Saturday and Sunday closed. Because Dragon Thai now operates two Denison locations and its official homepage primarily promotes Morton Street, location-specific hours should be reconfirmed when timing is important.
good_to_know: This is Dragon Thai's larger traditional sit-down location at 613 N Austin Ave.
The Austin Avenue restaurant remains active alongside the newer Morton Street branch.
The Austin Avenue location does not have a drive-thru.

businesses.description: Eisenhower Yacht Club is a privately owned full-service marina located inside Eisenhower State Park on the Texas side of Lake Texoma in Denison. The marina offers more than 400 covered boat slips, dockominiums, fuel, a ship store, marine repair and service, boat and yacht brokerage, courtesy and sailboat slips, and rentals of kayaks, canoes and stand-up paddleboards. Its location inside one of Lake Texoma's major state parks gives boaters direct access to the lake while placing hiking, fishing, swimming and other park recreation nearby.
businesses.short_description: Full-service Lake Texoma marina inside Eisenhower State Park with 400+ covered slips, fuel, ship store, marine repair and kayak, canoe and paddleboard rentals.
businesses.why_visit: Eisenhower Yacht Club combines full marina services with the recreation opportunities of Eisenhower State Park. Boaters can keep or service a vessel, fuel up and pick up supplies, while visitors without a boat can rent a kayak, canoe or paddleboard to explore Lake Texoma.
businesses.why_its_unique: Eisenhower Yacht Club is the privately operated marina located directly inside Eisenhower State Park. That setting combines a substantial full-service marina with immediate access to the park's cliffs, trails, fishing areas, swim cove and other Lake Texoma recreation.
businesses.phone_note: Current Texas Parks & Wildlife, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Discover Denison and regional marina sources all use 903-463-3999.

Eisenhower State Park itself is currently open daily 8:00 AM–4:30 PM, but those park hours should not be represented as the yacht club's business hours. Contact 903-463-3999 before visiting when access to the office, fuel dock, store or rentals is important.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 505 W Main St, Denison, TX 75020 — third-generation family-owned fine jeweler, repair shop and gift store in historic downtown Denison
businesses.description: Gray's Jewelers is a third-generation, family-owned jewelry and gift store that has served downtown Denison since 1941. The shop carries engagement rings, wedding bands, silver and gold jewelry, precious-stone pieces, earrings, bracelets, watches and other fine jewelry across a range of styles and price points. Gray's also provides engraving, custom-ordered class rings and in-house repair services including ring sizing, broken-chain repair and watch repair. Its adjoining gift selection includes Christian books and Bibles, music, greeting cards, figurines, china, crystal, flatware and other gifts for weddings and special occasions.
businesses.short_description: Third-generation downtown Denison jeweler since 1941 offering fine jewelry, bridal rings, watches, engraving, class rings, in-house repairs and Christian gifts.
businesses.why_visit: Gray's Jewelers combines the expertise of a long-established local jeweler with a traditional gift shop. It is useful whether visitors are shopping for an engagement or wedding ring, looking for a special gift, ordering a class ring, having an heirloom repaired or simply browsing jewelry and Christian gifts while exploring downtown Denison.
businesses.why_its_unique: Few downtown Denison retailers can point to more than eight decades of continuous local history. Gray's remains a family-owned, third-generation operation while offering both retail jewelry and hands-on services such as engraving, ring sizing, chain repair and watch repair under one roof.

tags: Homes By Lainie Real Estate Group
businesses.description: Homes By Lainie Real Estate Group is a full-service real estate brokerage headquartered in Pottsboro and serving the Lake Texoma region, Grayson County, North and Central Texas and Southern Oklahoma. Led by broker and owner Lainie Ramsey, the team represents buyers and sellers across residential, lakefront, resort and other real-estate transactions. The brokerage maintains an active property-search website covering Pottsboro, Sherman, Grayson County, Lake Texoma, lakefront communities and additional Texas and Oklahoma markets, while regularly marketing listings and hosting open houses throughout the region.
businesses.short_description: Pottsboro-based full-service brokerage specializing in Lake Texoma, lakefront and residential real estate across North Texas and Southern Oklahoma.
businesses.why_visit: Homes By Lainie is particularly useful for people buying or selling around Lake Texoma because the brokerage is based directly in Pottsboro and actively markets lakefront, resort and residential properties throughout the surrounding region. Buyers can search active listings and work with local agents, while sellers have access to a team-oriented marketing and sales operation.
businesses.why_its_unique: The brokerage combines a Pottsboro headquarters with a strong focus on Lake Texoma and cross-state Texas/Oklahoma real estate. Its active Lake Texoma and lakefront property coverage makes it especially relevant to people considering a permanent move, second home, investment property or lake-area property purchase.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 2811 S Trail Dr, Denison, TX 75020 — longtime Texoma seafood and Southern-food restaurant that originated in Pottsboro before relocating to Denison in 1994
businesses.description: Huck's Catfish is a longtime Texoma seafood restaurant known for Mississippi Delta-style catfish, Southern sides and a relaxed family-restaurant atmosphere. Huck's originated in Pottsboro in the early 1990s under founder John Payne before relocating to Denison in 1994. The restaurant serves fried, grilled and blackened catfish along with other seafood, shrimp, stuffed crab and additional American and Southern dishes. Meals are closely associated with Huck's signature hush puppies and green tomato relish, along with traditional sides such as pinto beans, coleslaw, fried okra and potatoes. The business was later sold, and longtime employee Carol Ramsey is the current owner, continuing a restaurant tradition that predates the Denison location.
businesses.short_description: Longtime Texoma catfish restaurant that began in Pottsboro before moving to Denison in 1994, serving Mississippi Delta-style catfish, seafood and Southern sides.
businesses.why_visit: Huck's is a strong choice for visitors who want a genuinely established Texoma restaurant rather than a national seafood chain. Catfish is the centerpiece, but the menu also offers grilled fish, shrimp, stuffed crab, chicken and other Southern and American dishes, with traditional sides and longtime signature items including hush puppies and green tomato relish.
businesses.why_its_unique: Huck's is part of the region's restaurant history, beginning in Pottsboro before relocating to Denison in 1994. Its Mississippi Delta-style catfish, hush puppies and green tomato relish became part of its identity long before the current ownership era, allowing the restaurant to maintain continuity through both a location move and later ownership change.
businesses.address_note: Huck's current official website and current restaurant listings consistently use 2811 S Trail Dr, Denison, TX 75020. Some tourism-directory material displays ZIP 75021, but first-party and current restaurant sources support 75020, so TWG uses 75020.
businesses.hours_note: Current published sources agree on Tuesday-Thursday 11:00 AM-8:00 PM, Friday-Saturday 11:00 AM-9:00 PM, Sunday 11:00 AM-2:00 PM and Monday closed. Holiday hours and occasional operating changes should still be checked before a time-sensitive visit.

businesses.history_note: Huck's Catfish began in Pottsboro in the early 1990s under founder John Payne before relocating to Denison in 1994. Regional historical reporting published well before the current ownership era documents the restaurant's Pottsboro origins and longstanding Texoma presence. Huck's developed a regional following for Mississippi Delta-style catfish, hush puppies, green tomato relish and Southern sides. After years of operation in Denison, the business was sold. Longtime employee Carol Ramsey, who current reporting says worked at Huck's for approximately 20 years, is now the owner. The current Huck's website displays 'Established in 2022'; because the restaurant demonstrably predates that year and has changed ownership, TWG treats 2022 as potentially connected to the current ownership or legal-business era rather than the historical founding of Huck's.

businesses.verification_note: Fully researched and corrected August 10, 2026. Huck's Catfish already existed in the canonical TWG directory as an unpublished candidate_needs_research record at slug huck-s-catfish, so this object upgrades that record and preserves the canonical slug. Current first-party information confirms active operation at 2811 S Trail Dr, Denison, TX 75020, phone 903-337-0033, current operating hours and the restaurant's seafood, catfish, Southern and American food offerings. Current restaurant sources independently support the address, phone, hours, takeout, delivery, kids menu and signature catfish and Southern-food items. Discover Denison confirms Huck's as a longstanding Denison restaurant and identifies Carol Ramsey as the current owner. Current July 2026 PBS/Daytripper reporting identifies John Payne as the founder associated with bringing Mississippi Delta-style catfish to the area and Carol Ramsey as the current owner after approximately 20 years working at Huck's. Earlier Texoma Living reporting documents that Huck's originated in Pottsboro before the Denison era, correcting the simplified impression that the restaurant itself began in Denison in 1994. Local first-hand recollection from a longtime Pottsboro customer independently matches that historical sequence and remembers patronizing Huck's at both its Pottsboro and Denison locations. The Denison relocation is identified as occurring in 1994. Because published regional sources describe the Pottsboro beginning in relative terms rather than providing a sufficiently reliable exact opening year, TWG uses founding_period='Early 1990s' and leaves founding_year null instead of inventing a precise date. Huck's current website uses the phrase 'Established in 2022.' Because the restaurant demonstrably predates 2022 and later changed ownership, TWG does not use 2022 as the historical founding year. It may refer to the current ownership or legal-business era, but the exact significance of that date and exact legal transfer date have not been independently verified.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 500 W Main St, Denison, TX 75020 — large downtown antique and vintage vendor mall with more than 80 vendors
businesses.description: Main Street Mall is a large antique, vintage and vendor mall in historic downtown Denison, Texas. The shopping destination spans more than 22,000 square feet and features more than 80 vendors offering antiques, vintage furniture, rustic and retro décor, collectibles, sports memorabilia, glassware, handmade goods and a constantly changing assortment of other finds. Individual vendors maintain their own booths and merchandise, making the mall a destination for antique hunters, collectors, decorators and casual browsers.
businesses.short_description: Downtown Denison antique and vintage mall with more than 22,000 square feet, 80-plus vendors, collectibles, furniture, décor and unique finds.
businesses.why_visit: Main Street Mall is one of downtown Denison's strongest treasure-hunting stops. Its size and large number of independent vendors create enough variety for visitors to spend an hour or two browsing antiques, vintage furniture, décor, collectibles, memorabilia and one-of-a-kind pieces while exploring Main Street.
businesses.why_its_unique: Rather than functioning as a single antique shop, Main Street Mall brings more than 80 independent vendors together across more than 22,000 square feet. Inventory changes continually as vendors refresh their booths, giving repeat visitors a different browsing experience while also supporting multiple small sellers under one roof.
businesses.phone_note: Current number published by Main Street Mall's official website and independently corroborated by Discover Denison and Antique Trail.
businesses.hours_note: Discover Denison, the current Antique Trail listing and current information from a tenant inside Main Street Mall agree on Monday-Saturday 10:00 AM-6:00 PM and Sunday 1:00 PM-5:00 PM. One mapping service currently shows Sunday closing at 4:00 PM; TWG uses the repeatedly corroborated 5:00 PM closing time while recommending verification around holidays.
amenities: More than 22,000 square feet of shopping
good_to_know: Main Street Mall is located at 500 W Main St in historic downtown Denison.

The current Antique Trail listing independently corroborates the address, phone, hours, 22,000-square-foot size and 80-plus-vendor count.
Antique Trail currently identifies CJ Reese as the Main Street Mall contact.
A 2026 interview with CJ Reese states that she purchased Main Street Mall in 2018.
Main Street Mall currently operates a $20 Live Shopping Sale every Thursday at 6:30 PM through its Facebook presence.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 311 W Main St, Denison, TX 75020 — size-inclusive women's boutique, gift shop, denim fitting destination and Hat Bar in historic downtown Denison
businesses.description: Monarch Boutique is a size-inclusive women's fashion, accessories and gift boutique in historic downtown Denison. The shop carries dresses, tops, denim, bottoms, jewelry, hats, shoes, handbags, home goods and gift items, with new merchandise introduced regularly. Monarch also offers personalized denim fittings and a Hat Bar that operates on Saturdays and by reservation, while hosting shopping events and other special gatherings throughout the year.
businesses.short_description: Size-inclusive downtown Denison boutique with women's fashion, denim fittings, accessories, gifts, home goods, a Hat Bar and recurring shopping events.
businesses.why_visit: Monarch Boutique offers a more personalized shopping experience than a conventional clothing store. Visitors can browse fashion and gifts, get help finding properly fitting denim, or make a shopping trip more experiential through the boutique's Hat Bar and special events.
businesses.why_its_unique: Monarch combines size-inclusive women's fashion with personalized styling, denim fittings, a Saturday and reservation-based Hat Bar, home and gift merchandise and an active event calendar. Its denim program includes styles through size 22, and the boutique emphasizes helping customers find clothing that fits both their body and personal style.
businesses.phone_note: Current phone number published directly by Monarch Boutique and independently corroborated by Discover Denison and current local business data.
businesses.hours_note: Monarch Boutique's current official website says the Denison store is open Tuesday through Saturday, with Tuesday-Friday hours of 10:00 AM-6:00 PM and Saturday 10:00 AM-5:00 PM; Sunday is explicitly closed. One current map listing displays limited Monday hours, but because the first-party store page explicitly says the store is open Tuesday through Saturday, TWG treats Monday as closed unless the business publishes an updated first-party schedule.

at_a_glance.average_visit: 30–60 minutes; longer for a denim fitting, Hat Bar visit or special event

The business's name and branding draw on the transformation symbolism of the monarch butterfly and owner Shari-Lee's connection between Manitoba and Texas.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 13015 N State Hwy 289, Pottsboro, TX 75076 — family-owned Italian restaurant serving the Pottsboro and Lake Texoma area
businesses.description: Napoli's Italian Restaurant is a family-owned Pottsboro restaurant serving scratch-made Italian cuisine near Lake Texoma. The menu ranges from homemade pastas, lasagna and classic chicken and veal dishes to seafood, pizza, calzones, stromboli, sandwiches, salads and Italian desserts. Napoli's also operates a full bar, offers lunch specials and a children's menu, provides catering, accepts reservations and hosts private celebrations and business gatherings.
businesses.short_description: Family-owned Pottsboro Italian restaurant serving scratch-made pasta, pizza, seafood and desserts with a full bar, catering and private-event options.
businesses.why_visit: Napoli's gives Lake Texoma visitors and Pottsboro locals a full-service alternative to the area's barbecue, burgers and lakefront fare. It works equally well for pizza and a casual family meal, a pasta or seafood dinner, drinks at the bar, takeout, or a larger catered gathering.
businesses.why_its_unique: Napoli's combines a broad old-school Italian-American menu with house-made dishes, specialty chicken and seafood preparations, pizza, a full bar and private-event service. Its location on Highway 289 also makes it a convenient dining stop between Pottsboro and many of the major Lake Texoma resorts and marinas.
businesses.address_note: Napoli's current official website and ordering system both publish 13015 N State Hwy 289 / 13015 Texas 289. The Pottsboro Area Chamber directory currently displays 13105 SH 289, which conflicts with the restaurant's first-party information and appears to be an address typo. TWG uses the current first-party address.
businesses.hours_note: Current hours are confirmed by Napoli's active online ordering system. The restaurant's general contact page advises customers to call for current operating hours, so holiday and special-event changes should still be verified when timing is important.

businesses.service_area_or_location: 110 S Fannin Ave, Denison, TX 75020 — women-owned candle, charm-jewelry, gift and creative-experience shop in historic downtown Denison
businesses.description: Rae of Sunshine Collective is a women-owned creative retail shop and gathering space in historic downtown Denison. Founded as Rae of Sunshine Candle Co. in 2020 and expanded into its first storefront in 2022, the business centers on hand-poured soy candles made in Denison, custom charm jewelry, creative gifts and hands-on experiences. Visitors can shop the boutique, create custom jewelry at the charm bar, book candle-pouring experiences, participate in special classes and themed events, and shop online for candles, gifts and other merchandise.
businesses.short_description: Downtown Denison candle, charm-jewelry and gift shop with candle pouring, creative classes, custom jewelry, perfume experiences and frequent special events.
businesses.why_visit: Rae of Sunshine Collective gives visitors something to do as well as something to buy. Guests can make a custom candle, build charm jewelry, attend a themed creative event or browse locally made candles and curated gifts, making it a useful stop for friends, couples, celebrations and anyone looking for an interactive downtown Denison experience.
businesses.why_its_unique: The shop combines locally poured candles and boutique retail with hands-on experiences including candle pouring, custom charm jewelry and fragrance creation. Its official calendar also actively promotes themed nights, pop-ups and markets, giving Rae of Sunshine stronger event value than a typical gift shop.

businesses.description: Mill Creek Resort & Marina is a full-service Lake Texoma marina and lakefront resort in Pottsboro, Texas. Located in a protected harbor near Lake Texoma's popular Islands area, Mill Creek offers more than 300 boat slips ranging from 18 to 80 feet, 10-plus boathouses, cabin and lake-house lodging, camping access, a seasonal fuel dock, dry storage, mobile lake homes, boat-lift and dock equipment, fishing access and independent professional fishing-guide operations. businesses.service_area_or_location: Texas-Oklahoma border, including the Denison, Pottsboro, Gordonville, Kingston, Mead and surrounding Lake Texoma communities
businesses.description: Lake Texoma is a major reservoir spanning the Texas-Oklahoma border and one of the region's leading outdoor recreation and vacation destinations. The lake offers approximately 89,000 surface acres for fishing, boating, sailing, kayaking, paddleboarding, swimming and other water recreation. Surrounding destinations include public parks, state parks, campgrounds, marinas, resorts, boat rentals, fishing guides, hiking and equestrian trails, wildlife refuges, restaurants, lodging and communities on both sides of the lake. This Texoma Weekend Guide hub brings together Lake Texoma attractions, businesses, access points and upcoming events in one searchable regional resource.
businesses.why_visit: Visit Lake Texoma for fishing, boating, beaches, camping, hiking, wildlife watching, waterfront dining and year-round getaways. Visitors can plan anything from a quiet day at a public park to a full vacation involving a resort, marina, fishing charter, boat rental and events around the lake.
businesses.why_its_unique: Lake Texoma crosses the Texas-Oklahoma border and supports an unusually broad mix of recreation, tourism and wildlife experiences. It is widely known for striped-bass fishing and is one of the relatively few reservoirs where striped bass reproduce naturally. Its irregular shoreline connects dozens of parks, marinas, resorts, communities and attractions across two states.
businesses.hours_note: Lake Texoma does not have one universal set of operating hours. Access hours, seasonal schedules, admission fees and closures vary by park, marina, boat ramp, campground, resort and attraction. Check the individual destination before making a dedicated trip.
amenities: More than 1,000 campsites around the lake
U.S. Army Corps of Engineers parks
good_to_know: Lake Texoma spans both Texas and Oklahoma, so regulations and licensing requirements can vary according to location and activity.
Anglers may use the appropriate Texas or Oklahoma fishing license for that state's waters or purchase a Lake Texoma fishing license that covers both sides of the lake.
Access fees, parking fees, camping rates and reservation requirements vary by individual park, marina, resort and recreation area.
Boat-ramp availability can change with lake levels, construction, weather and seasonal conditions.
Zebra mussels are present in Lake Texoma. Boaters should clean, drain and dry boats, trailers, livewells, bait containers and other equipment before entering another body of water.
Not every shoreline area offers public access. Use established parks, ramps, marinas and designated recreation areas.
Swimming areas may not have lifeguards. Review local safety rules and current conditions before entering the water.
Pet rules differ by property. Dogs generally must remain leashed outside designated off-leash areas.
The Texoma Weekend Guide Lake Texoma hub is intended to include businesses, attractions and events located within approximately 10 miles of the shoreline.
Individual destination pages should be treated as the source for current hours, fees, reservations, amenities and access conditions.

Popular choices include chicken fried steak, chicken fried chicken, the Magnolia Club Sandwich, the Farmer's Skillet and traditional breakfast plates. The cafe offers a casual dining room where families, friends and longtime regulars can gather for generous portions and familiar meals.
businesses.why_visit: Magnolia Cafe is a practical choice when your group wants familiar, filling food without limiting the meal to breakfast or dinner hours. Guests can choose from all-day breakfast favorites, burgers, sandwiches, salads and homestyle plates, making it especially useful for families or groups whose members want different types of meals.
businesses.why_its_unique: Unlike many breakfast-focused cafes, Magnolia Cafe serves breakfast, lunch and dinner six days a week, with Sunday breakfast and lunch service. Its combination of all-day breakfast selections, traditional diner favorites, generous homestyle plates and long operating hours gives Durant diners a broad locally owned alternative to national chains.
businesses.hours_note: Sunday service ends at 3:00 PM. Delivery-platform ordering windows may begin later or end earlier than the restaurant's public dining hours. Holiday hours and special-event hours may vary.

businesses.description: Highport Marina is a full-service marina and Lake Texoma destination in Pottsboro, Texas. The marina offers more than 1,000 wet slips along with covered and open dock options, private boathouses and dockominiums, pontoon and tritoon rentals, a four-lane public boat ramp, fuel dock, ship store, marine services, boat sales support and waterfront dining. Highport is also a major Lake Texoma event hub, with seasonal live music, boating traditions, community events, holiday activities and its well-known waterfront fireworks celebration.

businesses.why_its_unique: Highport combines large-scale marina infrastructure with dining, entertainment, rentals, marine services and recurring events in a single Lake Texoma destination. Its location also connects multiple TWG records, including Lake Texoma itself and The Island Bar & Grill.
businesses.management_note: Highport operates within the Waterview Marinas network. TWG is not asserting a specific legal ownership structure for the entire property.

businesses.description: Texoma Striper Kings is a full-time Lake Texoma striped-bass fishing guide service operating from Grandpappy Point Resort & Marina in Denison, Texas. Led by longtime professional angler Coy Devoll, the service specializes in guided striper trips using artificial lures rather than live bait. Trips are designed for experienced anglers and first-time fishermen alike and include professional guidance, rods, reels, artificial lures, life jackets, modern fish-finding technology, marina golf-cart pickup and cleaning, filleting and bagging of the day's catch. Texoma Striper Kings also accommodates larger family and corporate groups.
businesses.short_description: Full-time Lake Texoma striper guide service inside Grandpappy Point Resort & Marina specializing in artificial-lure fishing trips.
businesses.why_visit: Texoma Striper Kings offers a turnkey Lake Texoma fishing experience for both beginners and experienced anglers. Gear is supplied, the guide helps guests learn the techniques, transportation from the marina parking area to the dock is provided, and the catch is cleaned and packaged after the trip.
businesses.why_its_unique: The service distinguishes itself by fishing exclusively with artificial lures and combining decades of professional angling experience with modern sonar technology. Rather than simply putting guests on fish, the guide emphasizes teaching anglers how to cast, retrieve and actively fish for Lake Texoma striped bass.
businesses.history_note: Coy Devoll's official biography states that he first fished Lake Texoma in 2015 and later started Texoma Striper Kings after deciding to fish the lake full time. An exact business founding date was not verified.
businesses.hours_note: Guided trips operate by reservation and availability rather than standard storefront hours. Contact Texoma Striper Kings to schedule a trip.

businesses.description: Texoma Sailing Club is a Lake Texoma sailing, racing and social club based in its clubhouse inside Grandpappy Point Resort & Marina in Denison, Texas. Grandpappy identifies TSC as Lake Texoma's largest sailing club. The organization offers full and associate memberships, an active sailboat racing program, flotilla-style fun sails, raft-ups, educational programs and a year-round calendar of dinners, parties and social gatherings. Members have access to a clubhouse overlooking the marina with a full kitchen, restrooms and showers, barbecue grills, Wi-Fi, television and a large outdoor deck. Boat ownership is not required for associate membership, and sailors from outside the club are welcomed at qualifying on-water activities.
businesses.short_description: Lake Texoma sailing and social club at Grandpappy Point offering racing, cruising, education, social events and year-round clubhouse access.
businesses.why_visit: Texoma Sailing Club gives experienced sailors and people who simply want to get involved with sailing a community on Lake Texoma. Boat ownership is not required to join as an associate member, and the club combines racing and on-water activities with an unusually active year-round social calendar.
businesses.why_its_unique: TSC combines one of Lake Texoma's most active organized sailing programs with its own marina-overlook clubhouse, racing series, regattas, casual fun sails, raft-ups, educational opportunities and regular social events. Grandpappy Point identifies it as Lake Texoma's largest sailing club.

businesses.description: Lighthouse Resort & Marina is a year-round Lake Texoma resort and full-service marina on Preston Point near Pottsboro, Texas. The destination combines furnished cabin lodging, waterfront RV sites, covered boat slips and boathouses, a fuel dock and general store, tritoon and small-watercraft rentals, boat launches, fishing access, professional fishing-guide connections, recreational experiences and waterfront event facilities. Lighthouse currently advertises 35 furnished cabins and 20 waterfront RV sites, along with 20- to 50-foot boat slips and a variety of ways for families, anglers, boaters, groups and overnight guests to experience Lake Texoma.
businesses.short_description: Year-round Lake Texoma resort and marina with cabins, waterfront RV sites, boat rentals, slips, fuel, fishing, recreation and event facilities.
businesses.why_visit: Lighthouse works as an all-in-one Lake Texoma base for visitors who want to stay on the water and have boating, fishing and recreation close at hand. Guests can stay in a cabin or waterfront RV site, rent a boat or paddlecraft, launch their own watercraft, fuel up, fish, book lake experiences and enjoy family activities without having to build the trip around several unrelated locations.
businesses.why_its_unique: Lighthouse combines a modern family resort and marina with unusually deep Lake Texoma history. The property traces its roots to Preston Fishing Camp, one of the lake's early commercial marinas, and still maintains eight original Corps of Engineers cabins while offering current lodging, boating, fishing and event amenities.
businesses.ownership_note: Lighthouse Resort & Marina's official event-space page describes Texoma Destinations as its parent company. The official Lighthouse website footer identifies Cornerstone Marine Group, LLC dba Lighthouse Resort and Marina. TWG is preserving both official statements without making a broader legal ownership inference.
businesses.history_note: Lighthouse states that it has been a Lake Texoma family-vacation and fishing destination for more than 50 years. Its official history traces the property to Preston Fishing Camp, described as one of Lake Texoma's first commercial marinas after the lake was impounded in 1944. Lighthouse still maintains eight updated original Corps of Engineers cabins. An exact establishment year for the present Lighthouse Resort & Marina business was not verified.
businesses.hours_note: Lighthouse is open year-round. The official site currently publishes off-peak Main Office & Reservations hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Monday through Sunday and off-peak Fuel Dock & Rentals hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Monday through Sunday. Because these are explicitly labeled off-peak hours, check current seasonal hours before visiting.

businesses.description: Fastrac Charters & Cruises is a Lake Texoma cruise, charter, sightseeing-tour and water-taxi company based at the Lighthouse Marina Charter Dock in Pottsboro, Texas. Fastrac offers scheduled public cruises, private charters, narrated lake tours, dinner and sunset cruises, specialty and seasonal cruises, romantic experiences, lake-day and swimming excursions, custom boat rides and point-to-point transportation around Lake Texoma. Its fleet accommodates everything from couples and small families to large private groups, weddings, receptions, company parties and other special events.
businesses.short_description: Lake Texoma cruise and charter company offering public cruises, private charters, sightseeing tours, dinner cruises, specialty experiences and lake-wide water-taxi service.
businesses.why_visit: Fastrac gives visitors a way to experience Lake Texoma without owning or renting a boat themselves. Guests can book anything from an inexpensive sightseeing tour or family cruise to dinner at sunset, a private beach trip, romantic yacht experience or full private charter with captain and crew.
businesses.why_its_unique: Few Lake Texoma businesses cover as many different on-water experiences under one operation. Fastrac combines regularly scheduled public cruises, large and small private-charter vessels, catered event cruises, narrated tours, swimming and beach excursions and a point-to-point water taxi capable of moving guests among marinas, restaurants, islands and other destinations around the lake.
businesses.hours_note: Fastrac operates according to scheduled cruise departures, private-charter reservations and water-taxi demand rather than standard storefront hours. Cruise schedules change seasonally and are updated through the official booking calendar.

businesses.description: Big Water Boat Club is a Lake Texoma membership boating program operating through Lighthouse Resort & Marina in Pottsboro, Texas. Members pay a one-time initiation fee and low quarterly dues, then receive 50% off posted boat-rental rates at Lighthouse Resort & Marina along with access to member-only boats. The club emphasizes flexible boating without the costs and responsibilities of ownership, with no blackout dates, no complicated membership tiers and access to half-day, full-day, weekday, weekend and holiday rentals subject to availability. Membership also includes boating education, concierge assistance and discounts with affiliated Lake Texoma lodging, cruise and recreation businesses.
businesses.short_description: Lake Texoma membership boat club at Lighthouse Marina offering 50% off boat rentals, member-only boats, flexible reservations and boating training.
businesses.why_visit: Big Water Boat Club fills the gap between occasionally renting a boat and purchasing one. Members can boat more frequently at half the regular Lighthouse rental rate without paying for storage, slips, maintenance, repairs or the other ongoing expenses of ownership.
businesses.why_its_unique: Unlike higher-cost boat-club models built around large initiation fees and restricted reservation systems, Big Water uses a simple membership structure: a comparatively low initiation fee and quarterly dues, followed by 50% off Lighthouse boat rentals with no blackout dates or complicated membership tiers.
businesses.brand_relationship_note: BigWater.co identifies Big Water Boat Club and Big Water Marine as separate brands within the broader Big Water portfolio. Big Water Boat Club is the Lighthouse-based membership operation; Big Water Marine operates separate sales and service locations in Pottsboro.
businesses.hours_note: Boat Club use follows Lighthouse Marina rental availability and member reservations rather than separate published storefront hours. Reservations may be made for half-day or full-day use, including weekdays, weekends and holidays, subject to boat availability.

businesses.description: Buncombe Creek Resort Marina is a full-service Lake Texoma marina and resort near Kingston, Oklahoma, close to the Willis Bridge. businesses.description: Willow Springs Marina & Resort is a 150-acre Lake Texoma marina, lodging and recreation destination in Mead, Oklahoma. Founded in 1954, the property combines boat slips, boat and kayak rentals, lake access, cabins and lake houses, RV hookups, tent camping, swimming and picnic areas, fishing-guide access and the 16,000-square-foot Willow Wipeout floating obstacle course. The property also supports weddings, catering, parties, fishing tournaments, family festivals and community gatherings, with the independently branded The Ridge at Willow Springs operating as its dedicated wedding venue.
businesses.short_description: 150-acre Lake Texoma marina and resort in Mead with slips, boat rentals, cabins, RV and tent camping, swimming, Willow Wipeout and an on-property wedding venue.
businesses.why_visit: Willow Springs offers enough activities and accommodations to function as a complete Lake Texoma weekend destination. Visitors can stay in a cabin or lake house, camp in an RV or tent, keep or rent a boat, kayak, swim, fish, tackle the Willow Wipeout obstacle course or simply spend time along the waterfront.
businesses.why_its_unique: Willow Springs combines a long-established Lake Texoma marina and resort with a large branded floating obstacle course and a dedicated wedding business. Its current first-party site describes Willow Wipeout as the only floating water obstacle course on Lake Texoma, while The Ridge at Willow Springs gives the same property a separately branded destination-wedding component.

businesses.description: Chickasaw Pointe Golf Club is a public championship golf course in Kingston, Oklahoma, overlooking Lake Texoma and operating within the Pointe Vista development. The current course plays 7,011 yards from the championship tees with 18 holes, a par-72 layout, four sets of tees, rolling terrain, Bermudagrass fairways and TifEagle Bermuda greens. Amenities include a pro shop, practice facilities, equipment rentals, golf lessons and clinics, tournament and group-outing support and the independently branded Hilltop Grill onsite.

businesses.description: The Farmhouse Estate is a country bed-and-breakfast, vacation rental and event venue in Pottsboro near Lake Texoma. businesses.description: Texas Elks Camp on Texoma is a nonprofit lakefront camp, retreat and conference center in Pottsboro offering group lodging, meeting facilities, meals, outdoor recreation and educational programming on Lake Texoma. Founded by Derrick and Emily Roberts in 2015, the business creates a large assortment of sweet, savory, cheesy, caramel, chocolate and specialty popcorn flavors alongside freeze-dried candy and other sweets. Customers can shop in person, order online for nationwide shipping, arrange curbside pickup and order popcorn for gifts, parties, events and fundraisers.
businesses.short_description: Downtown Denison gourmet popcorn and candy shop with dozens of sweet and savory flavors, freeze-dried candy, gifts, party options, fundraising and nationwide shipping.
businesses.why_visit: Pop Around The Corner is an easy family-friendly stop while exploring downtown Denison, whether visitors want a quick snack, unusual popcorn flavors, candy or a locally made gift to take home. The wide range of sweet and savory options makes it useful for both casual snacking and gift shopping.
businesses.why_its_unique: Pop Around The Corner has grown from a locally opened downtown popcorn shop into a broader specialty-food business with handcrafted small-batch popcorn, unusual flavor combinations, freeze-dried candy, nationwide shipping, party favors, popcorn bars, wholesale sales and a structured fundraising program that lets participating organizations retain half of their sales.

businesses.description: A Timeless Journey is a downtown Denison vintage and antique business operating from two nearby locations. Its boutique at 106 N Fannin Ave focuses on vintage clothing and accessories, including dresses, furs, pearl-snap western shirts, boots, turquoise jewelry and special-occasion pieces such as wedding gowns, formal dresses and tuxedos. The companion antiques location at 431 W Main St expands the shopping experience with antique and vintage furniture, glassware, books, LP records, photographs and collectibles.
businesses.short_description: Two-location downtown Denison vintage shop offering clothing, western wear, formalwear, wedding gowns, antiques, furniture, records, glassware and collectibles.
businesses.why_visit: A Timeless Journey is a strong stop for shoppers who enjoy genuine vintage merchandise rather than newly manufactured vintage-inspired goods. Visitors can browse clothing and accessories at the Fannin boutique, then walk around the corner to explore furniture, glassware and collectibles at the Main Street antiques location.
businesses.why_its_unique: The business divides its extensive vintage inventory between two nearby downtown storefronts, allowing one location to emphasize clothing, accessories and formalwear while the other focuses more heavily on antiques, furnishings and collectibles. Its selection also spans unusually broad categories, from pearl-snap shirts and turquoise jewelry to tuxedos, wedding gowns, LP records and antique furniture.

businesses.description: Monsters on Main is a woman-owned maker shop in historic downtown Denison specializing in whimsical, one-of-a-kind monsters handmade from designer upholstery-fabric remnants. Owner and artist Nitia Musico developed the monsters from leftover materials generated through her long-running furniture and upholstery work, turning high-quality textile scraps into colorful gifts, companions and home decor instead of sending the fabric to waste. The shop carries monsters for children and adults, gift-oriented collections, home-decor pieces, pet-themed items and mystery selections, with online ordering, subscriptions, store pickup and wholesale purchasing also available.
businesses.short_description: Woman-owned downtown Denison maker shop creating one-of-a-kind monsters and gifts from upcycled designer upholstery-fabric remnants.
businesses.why_visit: Monsters on Main is the kind of business visitors are unlikely to encounter anywhere else on a normal shopping trip. Each monster has its own look and personality, and the use of upholstery-grade remnants produces colors, textures and patterns far different from mass-produced plush toys. It works equally well as a stop for children's gifts, unusual adult gifts, colorful home decor or simply something memorable from downtown Denison.
businesses.why_its_unique: The monsters grew directly out of Nitia Musico's furniture and upholstery work: instead of discarding designer textile remnants, she began turning them into quirky handmade creatures. That combination of upcycling, textile craftsmanship and playful character design has transformed an upholstery-shop idea into a distinctive Denison retail brand.

businesses.description: Wonder6 Playground — Pottsboro, branded by Wonder6 as its Cloud Castle location, is an indoor playground in Pottsboro Plaza designed for children ages 12 and under. Families can visit during open-play hours with day passes, multi-visit passes or annual memberships, and the location also offers semi-private and private birthday-party packages. The playground is located along FM 120 near Lake Texoma and serves as an indoor family-fun option for Pottsboro-area residents and visitors.
businesses.why_visit: A practical indoor option for families who need a place for children to play regardless of heat or rain, with flexible open-play admission and dedicated birthday-party options. The Pottsboro location is designed for children through age 12, making it useful for families with a wider age range than Wonder6's Sherman location.
businesses.why_its_unique: Wonder6 calls the Pottsboro location Cloud Castle and designs it for children 12 and under. It combines regular open play with a dedicated party room and an option to reserve the entire playground for a private party.
businesses.hours_note: Open-play hours. Wonder6 states that the location may close for private parties, so visitors should check the latest hours before making a time-sensitive trip.
good_to_know: The Pottsboro playground is specially designed for children age 12 and under; parents, guardians and older siblings may enter the play area for supervision.
A parent or guardian must sign a waiver for each child before the child enters the play area.
No shoes are allowed in the play area. Grip socks are required and are not included with admission; families may bring their own or purchase them at the location.
Food is not allowed in the play area. Party customers may bring cakes, food and beverages for the party area under the published party rules.
Current open-play pricing is $12.95 plus tax for a one-day pass and $7.95 plus tax for children under age 1. A 10-visit pass is $99.95 plus tax.

Current annual membership pricing is $199.95 plus tax for the first child and $100 plus tax for each sibling; membership includes unlimited age-appropriate open-play access and a published 20% birthday-party discount.
Published Pottsboro party packages currently start at $299 plus tax for a semi-private basic package, with premium and private-playground options available.

businesses.description: Deviled Egg Co. — Denison is a full-service downtown Denison restaurant built around gourmet deviled eggs presented in creative flavors and sushi-style arrangements. The restaurant expands beyond its signature eggs with made-from-scratch appetizers, protein bowls, flatbreads, egg salads, bagel spreads, party platters and other rotating menu items. The Denison location also serves beer, wine and craft cocktails, offers dine-in, carry-out, delivery and catering, and provides a separate reservable private-event room. Deviled Egg Co. was founded by Raechel Van Buskirk in 2017 and expanded into Texas with its Denison restaurant in late 2023 before growing to additional Texas locations. The company appeared on ABC's Shark Tank in 2025.
businesses.short_description: Downtown Denison specialty restaurant serving creative gourmet deviled eggs, appetizers, protein bowls and cocktails, with catering and private-event space.
businesses.why_visit: Deviled Egg Co. offers one of the more unusual food experiences in Texoma. Guests can sample multiple gourmet deviled-egg flavors, pair them with appetizers and cocktails, or build a larger meal from bowls, flatbreads and other menu items. Its downtown location also makes it an easy stop during a Main Street outing.
businesses.why_its_unique: The entire concept is centered on reinventing the deviled egg as a specialty dining experience, with flavors inspired by familiar foods such as crab rangoon, cheeseburger, walking taco and jalapeno popper. The Denison location combines that unusual concept with a cocktail-bar atmosphere, full dine-in service, private events and catering.

businesses.description: Briar Oaks RV Park is a Pottsboro RV campground near Lake Texoma offering full-hookup pull-through and back-in RV sites for short visits and extended stays. Recent improvements include a bathhouse with restroom and shower facilities plus a separate laundry room. Its Highport Road location places guests close to Highport Marina, The Island Bar & Grill, Tanglewood Resort and Tanglewood Resort Golf Course.

businesses.description: Eisenhower State Park is a Texas state park on the rocky southern shoreline of Lake Texoma in Denison. Visitors can hike and bike more than four miles of trails, swim at a sandy swimming cove, fish from the shoreline or two fishing piers, launch boats, picnic along the lake, geocache, explore native plants and fossils, and ride ATVs or dirt bikes on the park's designated OHV trail. The park also hosts ranger-led nature and outdoor programs, offers group facilities for gatherings, and contains the privately operated Eisenhower Yacht Club marina.

businesses.description: Willow Wipeout is a massive floating water park and obstacle course on Lake Texoma at Willow Springs Marina & Resort in Mead, Oklahoma. businesses.description: Perrin Air Force Base Historical Museum is an aviation and military-history museum located on the grounds of the former Perrin Field near Denison. Operated by the Perrin Field Historical Society, the museum preserves the history of Perrin Army Airfield and Perrin Air Force Base, which served the Sherman-Denison area as a major military flight-training installation from 1941 until 1971. Exhibits include historic aircraft, engines, uniforms, photographs, documents and military memorabilia, with displays covering Perrin Field, World War II, the Cold War and the broader history of American military aviation.
businesses.short_description: Free Denison-area aviation museum preserving Perrin Field history with historic aircraft, military artifacts, uniforms, engines and exhibits spanning World War II through the Cold War.
businesses.why_visit: Perrin Air Force Base Historical Museum lets visitors explore a piece of Texoma history that had national military importance. Thousands of military personnel trained at Perrin Field, and the museum preserves that story through actual aircraft, equipment, uniforms, photographs and personal artifacts. It is a particularly strong stop for aviation fans, veterans, families, history enthusiasts and anyone curious about why the former air base remains such a major part of the Sherman-Denison area.
businesses.why_its_unique: The museum sits on the grounds of the actual former Perrin military installation rather than presenting its history somewhere removed from the site. Its collection includes historic training and fighter aircraft along with artifacts tied directly to the people and operations of Perrin Field, giving visitors a local connection to World War II, Cold War aviation and decades of military pilot training.

businesses.description: Fort Washita Historic Site & Museum preserves one of southern Oklahoma's most significant military and First American historic sites. Established in 1842 as the southwesternmost United States military post, Fort Washita was created to help maintain peace and fulfill federal treaty obligations to the Chickasaw and Choctaw Nations in Indian Territory. Visitors can explore restored 19th-century structures, historic ruins and interpretive exhibits while learning about frontier life, tribal history, military activity and the Civil War. The Chickasaw Nation owns and manages the site and also presents living-history programs, reenactments, storytelling, outdoor movies, seasonal events and the annual Fur Trade Era Rendezvous.
businesses.short_description: Free historic Durant-area fort with restored 19th-century structures, ruins, museum exhibits, First American and Civil War history, reenactments and living-history events.
businesses.why_visit: Fort Washita is not simply a museum building; visitors can walk through an actual historic military site dating to 1842. The combination of ruins, restored structures, interpretive exhibits and outdoor grounds makes the history tangible, while regular living-history programs and special events give families and history fans reasons to return.
businesses.why_its_unique: Fort Washita directly connects United States military history, Chickasaw and Choctaw history, Indian Territory and the Civil War on the original historic grounds. The fort served as a U.S. military post before the Civil War, was occupied by Confederate forces during the war, was largely destroyed during the Confederate withdrawal, and ultimately returned to Chickasaw ownership. Today the Chickasaw Nation operates and continues restoring the site.

TWG uses the more conservative 4:00 PM closing time and recommends calling ahead if planning to arrive late in the day.

businesses.description: Frank Buck Zoo is a City of Gainesville wildlife attraction offering families and visitors an affordable opportunity to see animals from around the world, participate in scheduled animal encounters and learn about wildlife and conservation. businesses.description: Hagerman National Wildlife Refuge is an 11,320-acre U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service refuge along the Big Mineral Arm of Lake Texoma near Sherman. Established in 1946 to protect migratory birds and native wildlife, the refuge contains shallow marshes, creeks, bottomland hardwood forests, upland woods, grasslands and managed fields that support more than 300 bird species and a wide variety of other wildlife. Visitors can explore more than nine miles of hiking trails, drive the self-guided Wildlife Drive, fish, bicycle, paddle, photograph wildlife, picnic, visit the nature center and butterfly garden, or participate in free educational programs and guided tram tours.
businesses.short_description: Free 11,320-acre Lake Texoma wildlife refuge with hiking, birding, fishing, paddling, Wildlife Drive, guided tram tours, photography and nature programs.
businesses.why_visit: Hagerman gives visitors several completely different ways to experience Lake Texoma without needing a boat or paying admission. You can spend 15 minutes browsing the visitor center, take an hour-long drive or hike, or spend half a day exploring trails, fishing, birding and photographing wildlife. Because the landscape and migrating wildlife change throughout the year, repeat visits can feel completely different.
businesses.why_its_unique: Hagerman is both a major wildlife-conservation area and a public recreation destination directly connected to Lake Texoma. The refuge protects more than 11,000 acres of marsh, forest, prairie and lake habitat while still allowing compatible public activities such as hiking, fishing, biking, paddling, wildlife viewing and photography. It is especially renowned for migratory birds, with hundreds of species documented at the refuge.

businesses.hours_note: Refuge lands, roads and trails are generally open from sunrise to sunset daily. Wildlife Drive operates during daylight hours year-round when conditions permit. The Visitor Center is currently open Monday-Saturday 9:00 AM-4:00 PM and Sunday 1:00 PM-5:00 PM and is closed Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and New Year's Day. Flooding, weather and wildlife-management activities can temporarily close roads or portions of the refuge, so conditions should be checked before a special trip.

businesses.description: Red River Railroad Museum is a nonprofit transportation-history museum inside Denison's historic Katy Depot. The museum preserves and interprets the history of the Missouri-Kansas-Texas Railroad, commonly known as the Katy, and the enormous role rail transportation played in the creation and growth of Denison and North Texas. Exhibits use artifacts, photographs, documents, memorabilia and interpretive displays to explore railroad communication, steam and diesel technology, passenger travel, railroad workers and the arrival of the first train into Texas from the north. After operating at a temporary downtown location for several years, the museum relocated back into the historic Katy Depot in April 2026.
businesses.short_description: Free downtown Denison railroad museum inside the historic Katy Depot, preserving Katy Railroad history through artifacts, photographs, memorabilia and transportation exhibits.
businesses.why_visit: Denison exists where it does largely because of the railroad, and the Red River Railroad Museum tells that story in the actual historic Katy Depot. Visitors can learn how the first train entered Texas from the north, how Denison rapidly grew around the railroad, how steam and diesel railroading worked and what life was like for railroad employees and passengers.
businesses.why_its_unique: The museum is directly tied to the railroad that created Denison and is once again housed inside the historic Katy Depot. Its collections were assembled in large part by former Katy employees and railroad enthusiasts, giving many of the artifacts a direct connection to the people who worked on the railroad rather than making this a generic transportation museum.

businesses.description: The Birdie Den is a private indoor golf simulator facility in downtown Sherman designed for golfers ranging from beginners to experienced players. The facility uses a Uneekor EYE XO2 launch monitor with high-speed camera technology to measure ball speed, launch angle, spin, carry distance and other shot data while allowing players to practice and play simulated world-renowned golf courses with 4K graphics. Unlike a traditional multi-bay golf facility, each reservation gives the booking party private use of the facility. Monthly memberships offer extended or 24/7 access, while non-members can reserve casual hourly tee times during designated public-booking hours.

businesses.why_its_unique: Instead of placing several unrelated groups in neighboring simulator bays, The Birdie Den's model gives the person reserving a tee time the entire facility. businesses.description: Butterfield Stage Players is a nonprofit community theater in downtown Gainesville presenting live plays, musicals, comedies, dramas, youth productions and performing-arts programming. Founded by Cooke County residents in 1979, the organization has grown into one of the area's longstanding cultural institutions. Performances take place at 201 S Denton Street inside Gainesville's historic former Carnegie Library, where even the theater seating has local history: seats were repurposed from the Cooke County Courthouse. Butterfield also supports youth theater, classes, auditions, volunteer participation, special events and season-ticket programming.

businesses.description: Paramotor Flyers is a family-run powered-paragliding school and adventure-flight operation based at Durant Regional Airport in Durant, Oklahoma. Owner and instructor Shawn Elder offers tandem instructional flights for first-timers, full-day introductory training and complete powered-paragliding instruction for students who want to progress toward solo flight. Training takes place on a private three-acre field at the airport and combines ground handling, equipment instruction, safety education and supervised flying. No previous aviation experience is required for the introductory or tandem experience.
businesses.short_description: Durant powered-paragliding school offering tandem instructional flights, one-day introductions and complete paramotor training from a private field at Durant Regional Airport.
businesses.why_visit: This is one of Texoma's most unusual bookable experiences. Someone with no previous flight experience can schedule a tandem instructional flight and actually leave the ground beneath a powered paraglider with an experienced tandem-rated instructor. It works as a bucket-list experience, unusual gift or first step toward learning to fly independently.
businesses.why_its_unique: Very few Texoma attractions involve literally flying. Paramotor Flyers operates directly from Durant Regional Airport and offers both a low-commitment tandem introduction and a complete training path, allowing visitors to experience powered paragliding without traveling to a major metropolitan flight school.
businesses.hours_note: Flights and lessons are scheduled by appointment and are highly weather-dependent. The business flies year-round when conditions allow, with calm early-morning and evening air generally preferred. Unsafe weather is rescheduled rather than flown. Do not publish fixed daily operating hours without reconfirming them.

businesses.description: Texoma Jet Ski Rental is a mobile personal-watercraft rental company based in Kingston, Oklahoma, serving the Oklahoma side of Lake Texoma. Rather than requiring customers to transport or trailer a watercraft themselves, the company coordinates delivery and pickup at the customer's chosen boat ramp, dock, campsite or other approved Kingston-area lake location. Its rental fleet includes Yamaha WaveRunners capable of carrying up to three riders, with life jackets and basic safety equipment included. The business also promotes paddleboard rentals for visitors looking for a slower-paced way to enjoy Lake Texoma.
businesses.short_description: Mobile Kingston jet-ski rental service delivering Yamaha WaveRunners directly to ramps, docks and campsites on the Oklahoma side of Lake Texoma.
businesses.why_visit: Texoma Jet Ski Rental removes one of the biggest obstacles to spending a day on a personal watercraft: hauling it to the lake. Visitors can arrange a meetup at their Lake Texoma destination, receive the WaveRunner and safety equipment, ride for a few hours or most of the day, and have the company return for pickup.
businesses.why_its_unique: The mobile-delivery model makes this much more convenient for vacationers, campers and lake visitors who do not own a trailer or tow vehicle. Instead of traveling to a fixed marina rental dock, renters can coordinate delivery closer to where they are already spending the day on the Oklahoma side of Lake Texoma.
businesses.address_note: Current local business data places Texoma Jet Ski Rental at 6032 US-70 in Kingston. Older regional directories list 105 N Willis St and other Kingston-area addresses. businesses.description: The District is the family-friendly entertainment complex inside Choctaw Casino & Resort – Durant, combining 20 bowling lanes, a large arcade and a six-screen movie theater under one roof. Visitors can bowl by the game or hour, play redemption and video arcade games using reloadable game cards, or catch first-run movies in auditoriums with luxury seating and modern cinema technology. businesses.description:
Skydive Spaceland Dallas is a full-service skydiving center near Whitewright offering tandem first jumps, solo skydiver training and facilities for experienced licensed skydivers. First-time guests can make a tandem jump harnessed to an instructor after a brief training session, with freefall speeds around 120 mph and jumps generally made from up to about 14,000 feet. The facility includes a climate-controlled building, covered spectator area, showers, laundry facilities, gear storage, vending, an RV park, bunkhouse accommodations and food service. Skydiving is weather-dependent and visitors should plan enough time for operational delays rather than treating the reservation time as a guaranteed jump time.

businesses.description: Elevate Golf Club is an indoor golf-simulator facility in downtown Denison offering a high-tech, all-weather way to practice, play virtual rounds and enjoy golf with friends. businesses.description: Dixon Durant Park, widely known as Rocket Park, is a six-acre City of Durant neighborhood park on North 10th Avenue. businesses.description: Three Valley Museum is a nonprofit history museum in downtown Durant operated by the Durant Historical Society. Opened in 1976, the museum preserves artifacts, photographs, documents and exhibits telling the story of Durant, Bryan County and southeast Oklahoma from the area's beginnings in the 19th century through the present. One of its signature attractions is a second-floor small-town exhibit recreating more than 20 businesses and scenes from the early 1900s, including a law office, doctor's office, child's room, parlor and general store. Other major exhibits explore regional transportation history and Native American history in southeast Oklahoma. The museum also maintains a gift shop and presents historical programs, fundraisers, educational events and community activities.
businesses.short_description: Downtown Durant history museum featuring Bryan County artifacts, a recreated early-1900s town with more than 20 businesses, transportation exhibits and a Native American Gallery.
businesses.why_visit: Three Valley Museum gives visitors a much deeper look at Durant than they can get simply walking downtown. The upstairs recreated town lets guests step into recognizable early-1900s spaces while the rest of the collection connects local families, transportation, commerce and Native American history to the development of Bryan County.
businesses.why_its_unique: The museum's recreated early-1900s town is much more immersive than a conventional display-case history exhibit. More than 20 businesses and period scenes create a miniature historic community inside the museum, making local history easier to visualize and explore.
businesses.address_note: Discover Durant identifies the museum as occupying Durant's historic Carpenter's Machine Shop building.

businesses.description: Bonham State Park is a 261-acre Texas state park southeast of Bonham built around a scenic 65-acre lake, wooded hills and historic Civilian Conservation Corps structures. Visitors can hike or bike 8.75 miles of trails, fish from the bank or pier, swim, paddle, geocache, watch wildlife, camp along the lake or attend ranger-led nature and history programs. The park rents kayaks, canoes and paddle boats when weather permits and offers campsites ranging from full hookups to tent sites with electricity. Group camping and a reservable lakeside pavilion make the park useful for reunions, retreats and organized outings as well as casual day trips.
businesses.short_description: 261-acre Bonham state park with a 65-acre lake, 8.75 miles of trails, swimming, fishing, paddling, camping, CCC history and regular ranger programs.
businesses.why_visit: Bonham State Park packs an unusually broad range of outdoor activities into a relatively compact park. Visitors can hike, bike, swim, fish, paddle or picnic during a day trip, while campers can stay overnight beside the lake and take advantage of ranger programs and nature activities.
businesses.why_its_unique: The combination of a small scenic lake, extensive trail mileage and surviving Civilian Conservation Corps craftsmanship gives Bonham State Park more character than a simple day-use recreation area. Much of the park infrastructure traces back to CCC work completed during the 1930s.
businesses.address_note: The park is southeast of Bonham. TPWD directions route visitors from State Highway 78 to FM 271 and Park Road 24.
businesses.hours_note: The park is currently open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Current headquarters/office hours are 8:15 AM-4:45 PM. The park frequently reaches capacity, so TPWD strongly recommends reserving both day-use passes and campsites in advance.

businesses.description: The Medal of Honor Host City Museum at North Central Texas College in Gainesville preserves and shares the stories, artifacts and legacies of Medal of Honor recipients while exploring broader American military history. The museum's collection includes personal artifacts, military uniforms, documents, photographs, audiovisual and oral-history material, medals, awards and other objects that connect visitors with the lives and service of American military heroes. Beyond its permanent exhibits, the museum hosts educational programming, public lectures, field trips, private tours and community events designed to connect visitors of all ages with themes of courage, sacrifice, service and citizenship.
businesses.short_description: Gainesville military-history museum preserving Medal of Honor recipient stories and artifacts, with exhibits, educational programs, field trips, private tours and public lectures.
businesses.why_visit: The museum gives visitors a chance to connect Medal of Honor history with the people behind the award through actual artifacts, photographs, documents and personal material rather than treating the Medal of Honor as an abstract military decoration. Its educational programs and lectures also make it a repeatable history destination rather than a one-time exhibit stop.
businesses.why_its_unique: Gainesville has operated its Medal of Honor Host City Program since 2001, creating an unusually deep local connection with living Medal of Honor recipients. The museum turns that community tradition into a permanent place where recipient stories and donated artifacts can be preserved, interpreted and shared year-round.

businesses.description: Frontier Village & Museum is a volunteer-operated living-history museum in Loy Lake Park preserving 11 of Grayson County's earliest historic homes and cabins, with structures dating back to the 1840s. Visitors can explore pioneer-era architecture, rotating museum exhibits and local-history collections while learning about the families and communities that shaped early Grayson County. The site also offers guided tours, genealogy and archival resources, heritage-skills classes, children's programming, field-trip opportunities and Living History events featuring demonstrations such as blacksmithing, food preservation and traditional frontier skills. Regular self-guided admission currently provides exterior viewing of the historic houses and cabins, while interior tours require a guided-tour booking or participation during designated Living History events.
